WelcomeText: Load a text file with one song title per line. Phonexis searches YouTube for each one and lets you pick the right video. All chosen links are exported as a list at the end.
WelcomeStep1: Load a .txt file — or drag & drop it here. You can also generate one from an audio folder.
WelcomeStep2: Pick the best video for each song. Skip, edit the query or go back anytime.
WelcomeStep3: Export the collected links as TXT, CSV or M3U playlist.
DropHint: Drop a .txt or .phonexis list anywhere in this window
NoApiKeyBanner: No YouTube API key configured — searches will not work yet.
ResumeBannerFormat: Previous session found: "{0}" — {1} of {2} songs done.
NoResults: No results found for this query.
NoResultsHint: Try editing the query or skip this song.
DoneText: Every song in the list has been processed.
TestModeHint: Generates fake results, no API calls. For trying out the app.
CacheOnlyHint: Only use previously cached results, never call the API.
ApiKeysHint: YouTube Data API v3 keys. Keys rotate automatically when a daily quota is reached. Stored encrypted on this PC.
GetKeyInstructions: How to get a free API key (Google Cloud Console)
ExtractorHint: Scans a folder for audio files and turns the filenames into a search list.
ExtractorEmpty: No matching audio files in this folder.
NewSessionConfirm: Discard the current session and start over?
AboutText: Batch YouTube search from text files. Built for DJs, collectors and music lovers.
AllKeysFailed: All API keys failed or reached their daily quota.
AllKeysFailedHint: Add another key in Settings or wait for the daily quota reset (midnight Pacific Time).
NetworkError: Network error — check your internet connection.
NoSongsInFile: The file contains no usable lines.
DlHowBuiltin: Downloads inside Phonexis and names every video after its track. Above 360p FFmpeg joins video and audio.
DlHowYtDlp: Runs yt-dlp for each video with the exact file name and folder.
DlHowIdm: IDM only downloads YouTube videos through its browser extension (from another app it saves the page, not the video). Phonexis copies the links and opens IDM: open them in the browser and use IDM's download button, then Rename & archive.
DlHowJDownloader: Drops one .crawljob per video into JDownloader's folderwatch folder, with file name and folder. Needs JDownloader's Folder Watch module (Settings › Extension modules).
DlHowHandoffPaste: Copies all links to the clipboard and opens the app: paste them there. When the downloads finish, use Rename & archive to name the videos after the tracks.
DlHowHandoffOther: Copies all links to the clipboard and saves them to a .txt file. When the downloads finish, use Rename & archive.
DlNamingHint: Each video takes the name of its track (Bicep - Glue.flac → Bicep - Glue.mp4). Lists loaded from a TXT have no audio file: their videos go to this folder.
DlFfmpegAsk:
FFmpeg is needed for videos above 360p. Download it now (about 80 MB, from gyan.dev)?

Yes = download FFmpeg · No = continue at 360p
DlErrFfmpeg: FFmpeg is missing for this quality
DlNothingLeft: Every picked video is already downloaded.
DlToolMissingFormat: {0} was not found on this PC. Set its path in Settings › Download.
DlSentFormat: {0} videos sent to {1}, already named after their tracks.
ArchHint: Pick the folder where your downloader saved the videos. Phonexis recognises each file (by video ID, or by title and duration), renames it after its track and moves it next to the audio.
ArchEmpty: Choose the download folder and press Find videos.
ArchUndoConfirm: Move the files of the last archive back where they were?
Ob1Title: From a list of songs to their videos
Ob1Text: Phonexis finds the right YouTube video for every song in your list, keeps the links, and can download the videos named exactly like your tracks.
ObFlow1: Load a .txt with one song per line, or scan a folder of audio files.
ObFlow2: Phonexis searches YouTube for each song, one at a time.
ObFlow3: You pick the right video: official release, live, remix — your call.
ObFlow4: Export the links, or download the videos next to your audio files with the same names.
Ob2Text: Phonexis searches for free, no key needed. For an official backup, add a YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud Console): it is stored encrypted on this PC and allows about 99 searches a day. You can switch engines at any time from the picker at the top of the window.
Ob3Text: Choose how videos are downloaded and where they go. Phonexis names each video after its track (Bicep - Glue.flac → Bicep - Glue.mp4). You can change this any time in Settings › Download.
ObLegal: YouTube's terms of service restrict downloading videos. Download only what you have the right to keep, for your personal archive. You are responsible for how you use this feature.
ObAgain: You can reopen this guide from the welcome screen (How it works).
DlHowMediaHuman: Copies all links to the clipboard and opens MediaHuman: click "Paste link" (or press Ctrl+V) there — all links are added at once. MediaHuman names videos by title, so after downloading use Rename & archive: Phonexis already knows MediaHuman's video folder and matches files by title and duration.
DlAutoAddedFormat: {0} links added to {1}. Start the downloads there; when they finish, use "Rename & archive" to name the videos after the tracks.
DlJdNoFolderWatch:
JDownloader's Folder Watch module is not installed, so it will not pick up the files Phonexis writes.

In JDownloader: Settings › Extension modules › Folder Watch › install and enable it, then restart JDownloader.

PsNameInTitle: File name contained in the title
PsDurationOffFormat: Duration differs from the audio by {0} s
PsSettingHint: Highlights the most likely video for each song (same name as the file, matching duration, official channel…). Enter picks it.
SaveListHint: Save the list as a .phonexis file: keeps audio files, edited queries and picks (Ctrl+Shift+S). The session also saves itself automatically.
DlMatchDates: Same dates as the audio file
DlMatchDatesHint: The video gets the creation and modification date of its audio file (also when archiving files from other apps).
DlErrStalled: Stopped making progress: tried again, still stuck
DlErrNoStream: No downloadable stream for this video
SearchEngineHint: Free search needs no key and no quota, but it can stop working when YouTube changes its page. The YouTube API is official and stable but needs a key (about 99 searches a day each). With two engines, the second one runs only when the first gives no answer.
SearchModeTooltip: Search engine: pick free, API or both, and in which order
EngineCoolingFormat: {0} failed several times in a row: it is tried last for a few minutes.
AddKeyForBackupHint: Add an API key in Settings to have a backup engine.
